differentiation.occupancy_preservation: The residual term moves the source-weighted codebook centroid relative to the target; the separation reward pushes source-selected codewords away from the target. This is not an attractive force between the source and target codewords, so it does not directly pull a transition's two codewords together. Its codebook gradients can nevertheless distort other codeword relationships.

vs_r8.why: The candidate reaches the codebook directly, unlike the inert encoder-only arms. Unlike the collapsed cross-entropy, its separation component repels source-conditioned codewords from targets rather than attracting the endpoints to a shared code. It is behaviour-conditioned residual geometry, distinct from global geometry regularization and conditional assignment entropy; structural preservation and downstream gains remain empirical requirements.

differentiation.vs_reference_arm: the reference arm is the untouched host; this candidate adds one term whose gradient reaches the codebook without pulling a transition's two codewords together

equation: For each codeword e_c, define the source-conditioned soft residual r_i = target_i - sum_c p_i[c] e_c, where p_i[c] = softmax_c(-||source_i-e_c||^2/tau). Define d_i = sum_c p_i[c] ||target_i-e_c||^2 and L = lambda * [mean_i ||r_i||^2 - alpha * mean_i d_i]. The negative distance term rewards source-conditioned target/codeword separation while the residual term transports the target relative to the source-selected codebook geometry.
expected_failure_modes: The residual and separation terms can oppose each other or move codewords away from useful target regions, degrading quantization or increasing frequency drift. Separation may raise pair-level ER without preserving marginal balance, prefix width, sequence information, or downstream recommendation quality.

forbidden_substitutions.reason: a quota on the assignment is the family that produced 39.5% and 24.2% occupancy without preserving the exported codes
a term that pulls a pair's two codewords together is what collapsed the level-0 codebook to two codes

hypotheses: Reject if source-target exchange leaves the loss unchanged, any declared gradient is zero or non-finite, or the exported codes fail any structural requirement or do not improve Stage-3 recall@10 against control.
